Module rollover or earn-out|Rollover or.decision: Keep "Earn-out oder Rückbeteiligung": both are the established German M&A terms.

Module asset transfer|Asset transfer.decision: Keep "Asset Deal": standard in German M&A practice and known to owners; the descriptive alternative is longer and less precise.

Module separation|Separation.decision: Keep "Separierung": used consistently in about ten places and understood by corporate sellers; "Carve-out" stays for the figures (Carve-out-Zahlen).

Module primary capital|Primary capital.decision: Keep "Kapitalerhöhung": the term owners use for new money; Q55 itself separates primary capital from secondary proceeds.

Leads and contributors|Board.decision: Keep "Gremien": covers Geschäftsführung, Beirat, Aufsichtsrat and Gesellschafterversammlung, as German governance requires.

Leads and contributors|CEO.decision: Keep "Geschäftsführung": the body that holds the CEO role in a GmbH; fits the Mittelstand.

Q07|repeatable earnings.decision: Keep "nachhaltige Ergebnisse": the IDW S1 valuation term (nachhaltig erzielbare Ergebnisse); the context excludes the sustainability reading.

Q23|Enterprise to equity bridge.decision: Keep the German name: owners understand Unternehmenswert and Eigenkapitalwert; "Equity Bridge" is adviser jargon.

Q38|investor preferences / distribution.decision: Keep: "Liquidationspräferenz" is the usual German term sheet term; "Erlösverteilung" matches German VC practice.

Q49 help|group tax arrangements.decision: Keep "(etwa Organschaften)": the most relevant German group tax arrangement in a carve-out; a local example, same meaning.

E01|Distinctive products or technology.decision: Keep "Differenzierende Produkte oder Technologie": common in German strategy language and matches the landing page; "unverwechselbar" sounds like marketing.

E07|Working capital.decision: Keep "Working Capital": standard in German M&A and SPA practice; "Umlaufvermögen" is narrower, "Betriebskapital" rarely used.

Specialist route|Specialist route.decision: Change "Spezialistenpfad" → "Spezialberatung" (status label "Spezialberatung nötig"): neither owners nor advisers say "Pfad". Applied in ui.ts, text.ts, narrative-template.ts, landing-copy.ts.

Action plan|Priority actions.decision: Keep "Vorrangige Maßnahmen": plain German; "Prioritäre" is bureaucratic.
